info.name: CYCLES_MATERIAL_OSL
comment: Cycles vendor extension: 'osl' material subtype accepting Open Shading
Language shaders. 'bytecode' holds precompiled .oso text and takes
precedence over 'source', which holds OSL source code compiled with oslc
at commit time. The compiled shader's input parameters become settable
via equally named ANARI parameters chosen by socket type: ANARI_FLOAT32
normal) and ANARI_STRING (string); unset inputs keep the shader's
declared defaults. The shader's first closure output drives the surface
(surface shaders only). Requires a build with WITH_CYCLES_OSL=ON and a
render device supporting Cycles' OSL shading system (CPU or OptiX; the
shading system is global per session and is enabled at device init).
Otherwise committing warns and yields an invalid material, so surfaces

objects.name: osl
objects.description: material driven by an Open Shading Language shader

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: OSL shader source code, compiled with oslc at commit time

parameters.name: bytecode
parameters.description: precompiled OSL shader bytecode (.oso text); takes precedence over 'source'
